rationale: The candidate meets my substantive endorsement conditions: useful contract checking precedes synthesis; exact expression semantics and artifact binding are explicit; solver discharge is labeled as an encoding result; infeasible assumptions cannot produce useful correctness claims; whole-program synthesis validation preserves immutable specifications; independent financial, PCD, correspondence and Preview obligations remain authoritative. The bounded corpus and deterministic/manual comparison provide a real stop-or-defer decision. Capacity allocation addresses my opportunity-cost objection. These are advisory design endorsements, not evidence that any feature or release gate is implemented or accepted. I read revision 2 in full and verified its SHA256. Its explicit inclusion of minimal replay in A1 resolves the staging ambiguity retained in my revision 1 endorsement. The bitvector clarification correctly attributes the proposed theory to Moriarty rather than asserting that Aeon already uses it.
retained_caveats: Encoding qualification remains the central technical risk. Passing the finite corpus and deliberate mutants does not establish that all admitted evaluator behaviors satisfy the encoded relation; the text appropriately leaves that correspondence unproved.

The predeclared corpus must include independently derived expected outcomes and should avoid relying on the same arithmetic translation as the checker. The explicit distinction between successful-execution safety and defined execution must remain visible to users.
The authoring usefulness gate must be allowed to conclude that synthesis should remain deferred. A3 is not an inevitable delivery commitment.
The at-most-one-active-implementation rule is a capacity policy for this proposed delivery plan, not a semantic prerequisite that retroactively changes accepted MC/SP dependency relations.

Preserving the full baseline roadmap and canonical register links is necessary when shortening the root narrative. A shorter presentation cannot lose numerical coverage obligations, historical gaps or scoped receipts.
changes_of_position: I accept encoding-established rather than my initial proved label. It communicates the current assurance boundary more accurately until encoding adequacy is independently established.

I accept a narrower initial arithmetic fragment and stronger conditional deferral of synthesis than my initial NEXT recommendation because exact error semantics and opportunity cost justify this scope.

I accept excluding an external Aeon producer from this integration rather than maintaining it as a parallel experiment. The explicit measured-need and separately reviewed amendment route preserves a rational way to reconsider.
Revision 2 resolves my replay staging caveat: A1 now owns minimal evaluator replay, and A2 owns enriched presentation. No blocking change remains.
